title: Sign up to IG Markets, Complete a $300+ Cryptocurrency Trade within 30 Days & Get a $150 Digital Visa Gift Card @ Finder
body:
Deal: Sign up to IG Markets, Complete a $300+ Cryptocurrency Trade within 30 Days & Get a $150 Digital Visa Gift Card @ Finder

[Oliver] Are each of the promotions not eligible to be combined with other promotions? Like ususally business will say not valid with any other offer
[JIMB0] To the moon, baby 🚀🌕 And if it goes to the centre of the Earth instead, apparently they’re covering the difference.
[1morphine1] how does it work if purchase with USDT? Or it has to be trade with fiat currency?
[theg00s3] "Complete at least $300 AUD of CRYPTO TRADING ONLY (inclusive of fees) in 1 BUY order within 30 days." is all it says in the T&Cs so i'm not too sure
[Robin2012] just signed IG Trading recently.
Can I still get this rewards if I sign this IG market?
[crackman] Does trade mean buy and sell ? If so sounds like it would conflict with the buy and hold IG promo.
A previous finder deal for eToro required you to trade by buying and selling
[theg00s3] In the T&Cs it says "Complete at least $300 AUD of CRYPTO TRADING ONLY (inclusive of fees) in 1 BUY order within 30 days"
[Krykey] Just a small heads up, had a quick read through the T&Cs, so sign up via finder link and website, but to qualify for the $200 IG Markets promo, trade must be done through the phone app
[theg00s3] the finder link takes you to a page where it asks you to download the app
[Krykey] Ye i just figured make the account on the top right via login, so the cookies tracks, have no idea if it will track making your account via the app link.
Doesnt say specifically that it needs to be done via website or app though, but finders a bit finicky so figured its something to do with cookies, hence the need to not have adblockers on when you click the links etc
[leeroys_dad] It did say the Finder email address has to match the IG email address.
But if you download the app it just wants phone number
[Krykey] @leeroys_dad: Yeah now that i look into it more, its even more confusing right, cause the $200 deal you have to use IG Markets, but IG Markets is seperate to your IG Trading accounts….so which is which for which promo? Finder im assuming is for IG Trading, and IG Markets deal is seperate i believe now…
[Krykey] @leeroys_dad: Maybe you dont even sign up on the website, and do it purely through app, but then how does it know since your IG Market doesnt use your email…even more confusing
[Pacify] @Krykey: My IG account used an email and phone
[Krykey] @Pacify: Did you do via App? theres 2 apps, one IG Markets: Shares & Crypto and the other IG: Trading & Investments?
Cause signing up via website or the IG: Trading & Investments app ask for mobile and email, but IG Markets: Shares & Crpyto doesnt seem to ask for email
[Krykey] @Pacify: Nevermind, i noticed one you verify your IG Markets account…then you input your email then lol
[Krykey] @leeroys_dad: Verify the account, it will ask for email then, just noticed.
[Krykey] Edit update: dont make account through website as that is a seperate trading account to IG Markets deal.
[mk8] @Krykey: OK so to summarise, to gain $150 GC plus $200 IG Markets deal, what do we need to do?
[Krykey] @mk8: Honestly at this rate im not 100% sure, but as long as you follow the link in finder, download the app and sign up there, verify your details and use same email as your finder to verify. that should qualify you for the finder $150, the promo, as it does say its for IG Markets not IG Trading (i.e shares account).
Qualifying for the $200 IG Markets promo requires you to make purchase in app, so just do the $300 trade there to qualify for both Finder and the IG promo i assume.
Will probably contact support tomorrow as its currently offline to confirm.
[realaccount627465746] @Krykey: the finder page lists this in addition to the $150 gift card
Welcome offer: Get up to $200 cash back into your IG account when you sign up, trade and hold crypto, shares and ETFs within 7 days. Offer ends 31 July 2026. T&Cs apply.
[ne-us] Will you have to report this gift card as a crypto profit (CGT) on your tax return?
[U30004] Caz its not profit from selling cryptos. Its like cashback
[not-true] This comment made me think of another tax implication - with any cashback or bonus gift card deal, are we technically meant to claim it as income? Clearly I haven't been, but implications for us all if we're meant to! Obviously also something not readily auditable.
[Found this from the ATO]
( https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/pdf?DocId=PSR%2FGA20044%2FNA… )
So generally not, but if you are earning the points through a business relationship (business purchases) then claim the reward for yourself, yes!
[leeroys_dad] Creating account - assume it is the FX type, not just Shares only?
[zooter] Love the effort you put into this deal. I'm thinking I'll just buy usdc instead of btc because even though IG promises price guarantee, for a smallish amount of btc you will only break even after fees if you cash out of gas fees if you transfer elsewhere
[txb] Finder $150 offer = unlimited number of customers
IG $200 & bitcoin mbg offers = First 1000 customers
Given the IG offers were posted 2 months ago I wouldnt trust it hasnt been exhausted
[zooter] wouldn't it be false advertising if the fact that it is applicable for the 1st 1000 customers is hidden in T&C. The T&C also says that the closure of promo would be mentioned on the website
[Notoriousbird] Damn made an account last month and used the promos they provided, missed the gift card now for being too early.
[biznis] i have a uk ig trading account, does that void me for this offer?
[Brick50] FYI finder no longer send you the GC automatically and won't notify you when it's ready to be activated, I can imagine they have saved lots of money doing so.
I logged in and found an outstanding reward I had to activate to receive
Also cannnot currently deposit any funds due to system error
[gonpleursb] Signed up yesterday, finder link -> qr code for mobile-> phone number -> add email later. Crypto platform is mobile app only, hence the qr code.
[Ponsonby] Gambling. Not sure whether promotions like this are covered by gambling advertising laws. You win some you lose more.
[alcadive] Never thought of it like that. Considering the laws are piss-weak against actual gambling I can’t see anything being done about this.
[69dollars] How long did it take for people's account to get verified?
[69dollars] Cheers for that, mines almost been an hour even though it says "should only take up to 5 minutes" lol. I'll keep waiting.
[Bizantine] Been a week since i signed up to their other promotion and still not verified
[onceupon8] Can you close an IG account and if so will you be eligible for future promotions?
[noren7] I'm so confused as to what any of this means 😭
[lars06] Gave it a go. Seems like a risk but worth a shot, thanks!
